$comment: template_version: 0.3.0. Registry v1 (#3): per-hop declarations of slide:p06-narrow-downstream (downstream never wider than upstream): aud, scope, lifetime, organization claims, exchanger. Checked by L16 of #6.
title: Hops v1

upstream.description: Hop (or, for a hop that receives tokens of several IdPs and mints one token, the list of hops: #58) whose token this hop narrows (for exchange / reissue / service). L16 compares this hop with every upstream hop

token_type.description: Token type of token_types.yaml on this hop, null when no token travels (a DB connection)

aud.description: aud of the token on this hop (resource indicator, RFC 8707). Downstream does not widen it

scope.description: scope on this hop. Downstream does not widen it

max_lifetime.description: Seconds; lifetime of the token on this hop (null when no token). Downstream does not exceed upstream unless narrowing_exception says why (a Txn-Token MAY outlive the presented token, draft-ietf-oauth-transaction-tokens-11 §6)

custom_claims.description: Registry rows of organization claims carried on this hop (or the values copied, for a DB hop)

added_claims.description: Organization claims of custom_claims that the upstream token does not carry and the exchanger of a reissue / exchange hop adds when it mints the new token (#58). source external_source: the value comes from a system that is not a token (the employee directory, a database, an API), named in system. source upstream_claims: the value is derived from the upstream claims listed in from (IdP-specific role and group claims normalized into the organization's roles). L16 accepts only these as claims missing upstream

authorization_details.description: authorization_details types carried on this hop, narrowed to its audience (RFC 9396 §9.1)

exchanger.description: Service that exchanges or reissues the token for this hop (null when the token is passed as is)
exchanger.$comment: Trace: req:p06-narrow-downstream.R2 req:p02-delegation-client.R3 req:p03-absorb-idp-differences.R1 req:p04-reject-missing-required.R3 req:p04-single-issuer.R4 req:p10-token-exchange-not-narrowing.R2

validates.description: What the receiver of the hop checks and whether it validates locally (accepted until exp) or asks the issuer

connection_max_lifetime.description: Seconds; lifetime of a DB / broker connection on this hop, compared with the token lifetime (slide:p07-lifetime-mismatch)

forwarded_headers.description: Claims copied into headers on this hop (L8: inbound headers of the same name are dropped)

narrowing_exception.description: Why this hop goes beyond its upstream. A string (10 characters or more) is the reason for a longer max_lifetime, accepted only on a Txn-Token hop (draft-ietf-oauth-transaction-tokens-11 §6, §13.15). An object may give aud (with aud_replacement on a token-exchange hop) and max_lifetime (Txn-Token only). scope and authorization_details never widen (§13.6) and extra custom_claims have no exception (L16)

aud_mapping.description: On a reissue hop whose new issuer names audiences differently from the upstream issuer (#58): for an aud value of this hop that is not literally in an upstream hop's aud, the upstream value that authorizes it (via aud: an upstream aud value such as api://orders; via scope: an upstream scope such as orders, for an IdP whose token has one aud for every API or no aud). L16 checks that the value is in that upstream hop's aud / scope

aud_replacement.description: A token-exchange hop (kind exchange) that replaces aud with one concrete audience equal to the hop's destination service, when the upstream token addressed the requesting service (narrowing by replacement, slide:p06-narrow-downstream). Needs narrowing_exception.aud. Not for reissue hops, which keep a subset of the upstream aud (L16)
